provenance_and_semantics.player_motion: Synthetic deterministic field-space speed profiles (rectangular onset/cessation, staggered ramps, partial-group motion, pre-snap movers). Timings and speeds are engineering fixtures, NOT recorded NFL player trajectories.
provenance_and_semantics.trajectories: FieldTrajectory / TrajectorySample objects constructed directly in field space. They are NOT the output of the Phase 1-4 image pipeline on video: no frames are decoded, no homography is fitted, no detector runs. Phase 10 is measured as a consumer of Phase 4 contracts.
provenance_and_semantics.ground_truth: Snap and play-end frames are properties of the fixture construction (the frame the first mover crosses the speed threshold, the frame motion stops). There is no whistle audio, no referee signal, no independently annotated broadcast clip and no real play clock.
provenance_and_semantics.geometry: Each sequence carries one synthetic coordinate_frame_id ('synthetic:<sequence_id>') except the explicit camera-cut sequence, which switches to a second synthetic frame. No absolute yard line is claimed anywhere; x_coord_mode is 'relative_10yd' by construction.
provenance_and_semantics.image_detector_accuracy: UNMEASURED. Phase 10 never sees an image. Nothing in this benchmark is evidence that image-based player detection, tracking or projection is solved.
provenance_and_semantics.end_to_end_video_accuracy: UNMEASURED. The unattended video runner (football_vision/evaluation/video.py) does not segment plays, because a play START is always a manual timestamp in this design; no video-to-play-segmentation accuracy exists.
provenance_and_semantics.team_labels: Not used. Segmentation is team-agnostic; collective motion does not require offense/defense identity.
provenance_and_semantics.thresholds: All thresholds are the frozen a priori defaults in football_vision/analytics/segmentation.py (motion speed 1.0 yd/s, onset fraction 0.45, baseline fraction 0.15, baseline 10 frames, sustained 3 frames, min tracks 6, quiet 6 frames, min play 6 frames). They were not fitted on any split, and TEST was not used to select them.
provenance_and_semantics.expectations: Each play declares a frozen 'expected' block (maximum tolerated snap/end error in frames, or the refusal reason that must be produced). Expectations are pass criteria declared before running; 'expectation_violations' counts mismatches and must be 0. An expectation is not a claim that the behaviour is good for real football.
provenance_and_semantics.refusal_semantics: A refusal is 'false' when the fixture ground truth contains a snap (or play end) that the segmenter did not emit, and 'true' when the fixture declares no determinable boundary. False refusals are reported, never hidden: they are the documented cost of a refusal-first design on low-visibility strata.

metric_definitions.snap_error_frames: |detected snap frame - fixture snap frame|; fixture snap = first frame a mover crosses the speed threshold
metric_definitions.snap_exact_match_rate: exact-frame snap matches / snaps resolved (denominator excludes refusals; refusals are counted separately)
metric_definitions.end_error_frames: |detected play-end frame - fixture dead-ball frame|; detected end = first frame of the sustained quiet run
metric_definitions.phase_frame_accuracy: frames whose predicted phase equals the fixture phase / all fixture-labelled frames (refusals score as mismatches, they are not dropped)
metric_definitions.false_refusal: the fixture declares a snap and the segmenter refused to emit one
metric_definitions.true_refusal: the fixture declares no determinable snap and the segmenter refused
metric_definitions.expectation_violation: a frozen manifest expectation (error bound or required refusal reason) was not met
metric_definitions.confidence: a priori contrast x usable-evidence coverage, capped at 0.99; NOT a statistically calibrated probability

sequences.description: Clean 22-player window: 20 quiescent frames, collective motion from frame 20 to 59, quiescent again to 79. Manual label supplies only start_frame; snap and play end must both be recovered automatically.

notes: snap = first sustained collective-motion onset after a quiescent baseline
confidence is an a priori contrast x coverage score, not a calibrated probability
play_end = first frame of a sustained collective-quiet period
not a whistle timestamp; NFL dead-ball rules are not modelled

sequences.description: One backfield player goes in motion at frames 8-17 before the snap at frame 25. Pre-snap motion must not be mistaken for the snap: 1/22 = 0.045 stays under the 0.15 baseline fraction.

notes: snap = first sustained collective-motion onset after a quiescent baseline
confidence is an a priori contrast x coverage score, not a calibrated probability
manual timestamp; not verified against motion evidence

sequences.description: Broadcast close-up stratum: only 4 tracks are visible, below min_tracks=6, so the moving fraction is not statistically meaningful and the snap must be refused even though a play exists. The play end is a manual timestamp and must pass through unchanged.

notes: refused: insufficient_tracks — 4 track(s) < min_tracks=6
manual timestamp; not verified against motion evidence

sequences.description: Staggered onset: the 22 players cross the motion threshold over 6 frames starting at frame 30 (a real snap is not instantaneous in field space), and the play end is left to motion cessation. The detector reports the first frame of the sustained collective run, so a small positive latency is expected and bounded, not hidden.

notes: snap = first sustained collective-motion onset after a quiescent baseline
confidence is an a priori contrast x coverage score, not a calibrated probability
play_end = first frame of a sustained collective-quiet period
not a whistle timestamp; NFL dead-ball rules are not modelled

sequences.description: Pile / heavy-occlusion stratum: a play exists at frame 25 but only 35% of the visible group ever produces reliable measured motion, so the 0.45 onset fraction is never reached. Correct behaviour is a refusal (false refusal against ground truth), not a guess.

notes: refused: no_sustained_onset — no 3 consecutive defined frames reached moving_fraction >= 0.45 after a quiescent baseline
manual timestamp; not verified against motion evidence

sequences.description: Camera cut at frame 40 changes the coordinate frame mid-play (snap 20, end 60). Speeds are not comparable across coordinate frames, so the whole window must be refused with coordinate_frame_change rather than segmented anyway.

notes: refused: coordinate_frame_change — the window does not hold one consistent coordinate_frame_id (observed ['synthetic:seg_seq_06_val_camera_cut', 'synthetic:seg_seq_06_val_camera_cut#post_cut']); motion is not comparable across it
manual timestamp; not verified against motion evidence

sequences.description: Occlusion stratum on a small visible group: 4 of 8 tracks coast (dead reckoning) during frames 5-9, so those frames have fewer than min_tracks usable measured samples. An undefined frame is unknown motion, not a quiet frame, so the pre-snap baseline cannot be established.

notes: refused: baseline_evidence_gaps — no candidate frame has 10 preceding defined frames, so pre-snap quiescence cannot be established
manual timestamp; not verified against motion evidence

Play 2 supplies only a manual start frame, so both its snap and its dead-ball frame must be recovered automatically. sequences.description: Warm-up / celebration window: the visible group is already moving at the manual start frame and never becomes quiescent, so there is no pre-snap baseline and no snap exists. The correct result is a true refusal and snap_unknown phase labels.

notes: refused: no_quiescent_baseline — pre-snap motion never stayed <= 0.15 of moving tracks over a defined baseline

sequences.description: Total-occlusion stratum: every sample in the window is a coasting dead-reckoning prediction (no accepted measurement anywhere). Dead reckoning is model output, so no collective motion may be inferred and no boundary may be claimed.

notes: refused: insufficient_measured_samples — no frame reached min_tracks usable measured samples (excluded: dead_reckoning=1320, rejected=0, coasted=0, unprojected=0)
